scope: Thematic collections that span dynasties and centuries — the cross-cutting groupings that don't fit any single events_*.json file.

collections.title: Founding moments of modern India
collections.subtitle: Institutions, orders, and administrative systems whose creation still shapes the subcontinent.
collections.summary: Five-century span of foundings — Sher Shah's revenue and road systems in 1540, Akbar's mansabdari in 1577, the Khalsa in 1699, the Indian National Congress in 1885 — each an act of deliberate institution-building that outlasted its founder.
